description: This file defines an abstract class 'HonoSampler' for integrating Hono with Apache JMeter. It includes configuration of server options, management of connection properties such as host, port, user, password, and endpoint, as well as semaphore handling for thread synchronization.

classes.name: HonoSampler
classes.description: An abstract class extending JMeter's AbstractSampler, designed for communication with Hono endpoints. It manages connection properties and synchronization mechanisms for test execution.

methods.name: modifyServerOptions
methods.description: Applies server options from a UI panel to local properties.

methods.name: configureServerOptions
methods.description: Sets UI panel options based on current local properties.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Retrieves the trust store path property.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the trust store path property.

methods.name: getPortAsInt
methods.description: Parses the port property as an integer with fallback to 0 on error.

methods.name: setEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the endpoint property based on enum.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Constructs a URL path combining endpoint and tenant.

methods.name: addSemaphore
methods.description: Increments semaphore count in synchronized block.

methods.name: getSemaphores
methods.description: Retrieves current semaphore count in synchronized block.

methods.name: removeSemaphores
methods.description: Resets semaphore count to zero in synchronized block.
